summary: Compugen Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders, held September 10, 2026, approved all proposals by the requisite shareholder majority. The notice, proxy statement, and proxy card were previously furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to a Form 6-K on August 3, 2026, and are incorporated by reference. No special-situation transaction, price, stake, premium, or advisor is disclosed. This is a routine foreign-private-issuer meeting-result report, incorporated into the company's Form F-3 registration statement; no risk-arb angle applies.
